channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Hessische Kulturstiftung: Reise- und Residenzstipendien 2027/2028 (18th round)
item.description: Hessische Kulturstiftung · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Travel grants of EUR 25,000 (3 to 12 months), plus access to up to EUR 7,700 additional production funding after the grant. 14 grants over two years: 5 travel, 7 residency (NYC, London, Paris, Istanbul, Kyoto), 2 combined. NOTE: figures are from the call text as republished verbatim by listing sites; the official funding-guidelines PDF was unavailable at the time of adding, so verify on hkst.de. No application fee.

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.title: EFFEA Call #5: European Festivals Fund for Emerging Artists
item.description: European Festivals Association (EFA) · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · 50 residency grants: 40 Discovery grants of EUR 8,000 (for artists at an early career stage) and 10 Springboard grants of EUR 15,000 (for artists established at home and ready to break through internationally). A minimum of 80 percent of the grant must cover costs incurred by the artists (fees, travel, accommodation, subsistence). An own contribution of EUR 1,000 (Discovery) or EUR 2,000 (Springboard) is deducted from the paid grant. No application fee.

item.title: Next Nature: Heaven's Hospital Open Call (commissions on the future of care)
item.description: Heaven's Hospital / Next Nature Museum · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Three selected projects each receive a budget of EUR 15,000 for the development of a first prototype or artistic intervention. Selected participants become Heaven's Hospital Fellows and join an international network of designers, researchers, care professionals and artists. No application fee stated.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kone Foundation: Annual Grant Call (2026)
    https://koneensaatio.fi/en/grants/grantapplicants/criteria-for-applying/
    Kone Foundation / Koneen Saatio (Finland) · deadline Closed 15 Sep 2026 · Artistic groups and organisations up to EUR 250,000; research groups typically EUR 200,000 to 500,000. Minimum project duration six months for individual applicants and one month for groups; maximum four consecutive years for the same project. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee. No retroactive funding.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Grounding the Cloud 2026
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-grounding-the-cloud
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline Closed 14 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 30,000 per grant. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• British Council Ireland: UK-IRL Culture Connects Grant 2026/27
    https://www.britishcouncil.ie/programmes/arts/uk-irl-culture-connects-grant-202627
    British Council Ireland / Arts Council Ireland · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Up to EUR 3,000 per collaboration (smaller amounts also eligible), covering artist fees (including your own time), collaborator fees, travel and accommodation, studio or space hire, materials, and access costs including disability support. No application fee.
  • Rijkscultuurfondsen: Interdisciplinary Grant
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/interdisciplinary/
    Dutch national cultural funds (Rijkscultuurfondsen), via the Mondriaan Fund · deadline Closed 01 Oct 2026 · Individual-maker track: EUR 24,900 for 12 months (income cap EUR 55,000 including the grant; awarded once per maker). Organisation track, two fixed tiers: EUR 12,500 for projects budgeted EUR 15,000 to 60,000, or EUR 50,000 for projects budgeted EUR 60,000 to 500,000. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Stimuleringsfonds + Film Fund: Immerse\Interact 2026 (second round)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/immerse-interact-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie and the Netherlands Film Fund · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · Development: EUR 15,000 for individual makers (plus up to EUR 5,000 coaching, max EUR 20,000) or EUR 25,000 for producers (plus up to EUR 5,000 coaching). item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Emergence Art+Science Fellowships: Open Call for New Commissions (Emergence Festival 2027)
    https://www.d-iep.org/artsciencefellowships
    Emergence at All Scales (EAAS), with The Science & Cocktails Foundation, Stichting Paradiso and NWA Route Kunst · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Production budget up to EUR 20,000 including VAT per project (covers artist fees, materials, equipment, space, travel, accommodation, installation and presentation). Total call budget EUR 80,000 (around four projects). No application fee.
  • (Perma)culture Open Call 2026 (Ceske Budejovice 2028 European Capital of Culture)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTTlZOjtEvvtKrkisZxHKecf2flkMl27a7-NeEkRVswjHGuQ/viewform
    Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Large projects: support up to CZK 4,000,000 (approx. EUR 160,000), min budget CZK 2,200,000, max 50% of total costs. Small projects: support up to CZK 1,500,000 (approx. EUR 60,000), min budget CZK 750,000, max 70% of total costs. Each project must include at least one international partner and at least one South Bohemian regional partner. Budget covers two years of preparation and implementation (2027 + 2028). No application fee.
